name: codeql
summary: Build a CodeQL database from a bootloader build, run a query suite.
notes: Needs a working build; recipes in tools/build_commands.json.
applies_to: Any bootloader that builds. Recipes for 15 in build_commands.json; U-Boot and barebox use sandbox targets, coreboot builds its own toolchain.

name: angr
summary: Load a compiled image and build a CFG; the base other angr tools sit on.
notes: Raw blobs need --base and --arch.
verified_on: shimx64.efi -> 3,017 functions; OVMF MnpDxe -> CFG recovered
applies_to: Any compiled bootloader: ELF (U-Boot sandbox, kexec) or PE (shim, GRUB, any DXE module). Raw blobs need --base and --arch.

name: binwalk
summary: Identify and carve structures out of a flash dump.
notes: You supply the image; the corpus holds source, not builds.
verified_on: OVMF.fd -> LZMA DXE volume + SecMain PE located
applies_to: Any firmware image or flash dump, UEFI or embedded.

name: uefi-firmware-parser
summary: Parse UEFI volumes, files and the Intel flash descriptor.
notes: You supply the image.
verified_on: OVMF.fd -> firmware volumes, SecMain, PE32 sections
applies_to: UEFI firmware images plus Intel flash descriptors.

name: fiano
summary: Walk and rebuild UEFI images (utk).
notes: You supply the image.
applies_to: UEFI firmware images, same as UEFITool. Go-based, good for scripting.

name: fwhunt-scan
summary: Match UEFI modules against FwHunt threat rules.
notes: Analyses a single UEFI module; --rules matches against a FwHunt rule set.
verified_on: OVMF MnpDxe -> 94 boot services, 32 protocols, 11 GUIDs
applies_to: Individual UEFI modules (PE32+) from EDK-II, Project Mu or an OEM image.

name: UEFITool
summary: Browse and edit UEFI images; UEFIExtract is the CLI.
notes: UEFIExtract report/unpack; --extract yields the individual DXE modules.
applies_to: UEFI firmware images: OVMF from edk2, Project Mu builds, OEM flash dumps.

name: MEAnalyzer
summary: Analyse Intel ME/CSME/TXE regions.
notes: Takes an ME region split out of a flash image, not a whole image.
verified_on: OVMF.fd -> correctly reports no Intel ME region present
applies_to: Intel ME/CSME/TXE regions, which sit beside the bootloader in the same flash part. Not present in OVMF.

name: chipsec
blocker: Offline image decoding only. The on-target modules -- SMM, SPI protection, Secure Boot configuration -- need a kernel driver on the live platform and cannot run in a container.
summary: Assess platform configuration: SMM, SPI protection, Secure Boot.
notes: Offline image checks exist (chipsec_util) but the security value is in the on-target modules.
verified_on: OVMF.fd -> EFI volumes parsed offline (chipsec_util -n uefi decode)
applies_to: UEFI firmware images offline. On-target platform checks need the live machine.

name: fwupd
blocker: Applying an update needs a privileged daemon on real hardware.
summary: Firmware update delivery; the write side of the boot chain.
notes: Offline firmware-parse/-extract only; the update path needs the live platform.
verified_on: shimx64.efi -> Authenticode hash and PE section layout
applies_to: Any firmware blob, offline. Identifies the container format and hashes it as Secure Boot would.

name: tsffs
blocker: Requires Intel Simics, which is not freely redistributable.
summary: Fuzz firmware inside a Simics full-system simulation.
applies_to: Anything Simics can simulate, including UEFI and embedded bootloaders.

name: uefi_retool
summary: IDA tooling for UEFI protocol and module reverse engineering.
notes: Only the IDA-free half. get-info and get-pp drive IDA Pro; get-images does not.
applies_to: UEFI firmware images, for module extraction only. Protocol recovery needs IDA Pro.

name: emmutaler
blocker: Needs decrypted Apple iBoot images, which are not distributable.
summary: Fuzz Apple's iBoot second-stage bootloader.
applies_to: Apple iBoot only.

name: ASPFuzz
blocker: Targets the AMD Secure Processor ROM on specific silicon.
summary: Fuzz the AMD ASP on-chip bootloader.
applies_to: The AMD Secure Processor on-chip bootloader only.

name: efi_fuzz
summary: Fuzz UEFI DXE drivers on top of the Qiling emulator.
notes: Needs patches/efi_fuzz-modernise.patch (5 fixes). Ships three worked examples.
verified_on: smram_arbitrary_write example -> DXE driver emulated, SMM protocols initialised
applies_to: UEFI DXE and SMM drivers from EDK-II or an OEM image. Ships three worked examples.

name: firmadyne
blocker: Same architecture as FirmAE and superseded by it: needs a host PostgreSQL database plus prebuilt QEMU kernels. Emulates Linux router firmware, not bootloaders.
summary: Emulate Linux firmware images for dynamic analysis.
notes: Needs postgres, qemu images and a populated database; superseded by FirmAE.
applies_to: Linux-based router and IoT firmware images. Not bootloaders.

name: FirmAE
blocker: Its download.sh and docker-init.sh do run unattended (the fcore image builds), but init.sh then does `sudo service postgresql restart` against a PostgreSQL instance on the host, which the fcore image does not contain. It also emulates Linux router firmware, so BootBench holds no target for it.
summary: Arbitrated firmware emulation; higher success rate than firmadyne.
notes: Ships its own docker setup: ./download.sh && ./init.sh, then ./run.sh.
applies_to: Linux-based router and IoT firmware images. Not bootloaders.

name: emba
summary: Orchestrates extraction and a large battery of firmware checks.
notes: Needs installer.sh -g -f run once against the checkout (~4 GB), config/gh_action, and the -i flag.
verified_on: OVMF.fd -> full scan, HTML report generated
applies_to: Whole firmware images, UEFI or Linux-based embedded. Broad rather than bootloader-specific.

name: FACT_core
blocker: Multi-container deployment with its own database, worker pool and web UI, installed by its own scripts against the host. Analyses whole firmware images rather than bootloaders specifically.
summary: Firmware analysis and comparison framework with a web UI.
notes: Multi-container deployment; follow the project's docker-compose setup.
applies_to: Whole firmware images of any kind.

name: BootStomp
summary: Taint analysis for Android bootloaders.
notes: Uses the authors' badnack/bootstomp image; run as -u angr and source /home/angr/.virtualenvs/angr. Needs a per-image config; it ships them with matching Android bootloader images.
verified_on: Qualcomm LK (unpatched, bundled) -> 2 sink alerts, 2 loop alerts, 1 dereference alert
applies_to: Android bootloaders only: Qualcomm LK (type2/lk), Huawei fastboot, Nexus hboot, Xperia LK. Needs a per-image config.

name: karonte
blocker: Setup is solved -- the runner stages Qualcomm LK from BootStomp and karonte starts and logs -- but a full multi-binary taint pass had not finished after 2.5 hours on the 3.6 MB LK image. Its paper reports comparable runtimes, so this is expected rather than broken; budget for an overnight run.
summary: Static taint tracking across firmware binaries.
notes: Uses badnack/karonte; run as -u karonte and source /home/karonte/.virtualenvs/karonte. Config bin paths are rewritten to the output mount because the image's tree is read-only.
applies_to: Firmware binaries with multiple communicating components. Ships configs for Qualcomm LK (type2/lk).

name: arbiter
summary: Static and symbolic detection of specific bug classes.
notes: Needs patches/arbiter-angr-api.patch and a real template; templates/bootloader_CWE190.py targets UEFI/U-Boot/libc allocation sinks.
verified_on: kexec -> 10 integer-overflow findings with taint histories
applies_to: Compiled bootloader binaries, x86/x86-64. Needs a template naming the sinks.

name: pesign
summary: Sign and inspect PE binaries for Secure Boot.
notes: Reports Authenticode signatures via sbverify and pesign.
verified_on: shimx64.efi -> signed by Microsoft Corporation UEFI CA 2011
applies_to: Signed PE bootloaders: shim, GRUB's EFI build, systemd-boot, any signed DXE module.

name: top4grep
summary: Grep the top four security conferences.
notes: Needs nltk corpora in the image. tools/collect_papers.py covers eight venues instead of four.
verified_on: keyword 'bootloader' -> 4 papers across the top-4 venues
applies_to: Not a bootloader tool: searches conference proceedings.
